shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | sed -n '1,240p'; sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md; sed -n '1,220p' package.json; sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do echo \"FILE:"'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.next/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort; if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json; fi; if [ -f README.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' README.md; fi"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs; git diff -- package.json next.config.ts app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/layout.tsx app/CardStats.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type CacheLifeProfiles|interface CacheLife|seconds|minutes|hours|days|weeks|max\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md | sed -n '1,180p'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md; rg -n \"fetch.*use cache|cache.*fetch|revalidate\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort | sed -n '1,220p' && rg -n -o \"Dashboard|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Loading chart|Latest Invoices|Loading dashboard\" .next/server/app -g '*.html' -g '*.rsc' -g '*.body' -g '*.meta' | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1p' .next/server/app/index.html | fold -w 180 | sed -n '1,180p'; git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff --check"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' .gitignore; git diff -- tsconfig.json; ls -ld .next next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; npm exec tsc -- --noEmit"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short; git diff -- .gitignore app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; git diff --check; npm exec tsc -- --noEmit'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p'; nl -ba .gitignore; git status --short; git diff --check"

/bin/bash -lc 'build_artifacts_dir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/ppr-build-artifacts.XXXXXX)"
mv /workspace/.next "$build_artifacts_dir/.next"
mv /workspace/next-env.d.ts "$build_artifacts_dir/next-env.d.ts"
mv /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo "$build_artifacts_dir/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo"
git status --short
git diff --check'
